turns.instruction:
Build the two-story single-span 6 m frame, levels 3.6 and 7.2 m, with a 1.5 m right overhang at each level. Main beams carry 10 kN/m downward and overhangs 6 kN/m downward. The lower main-beam midpoint at (3,0,3.6) m carries an extra 22 kN downward. Report global Ux and Uz at the highest-story rightmost beam-column joint, and global support moment My and vertical reaction Fz at the left base, for every listed case and combination.
Use the stated OpenSees engine for every computable changed state. First-order linear elastic analysis; self-weight, P-delta, rigid diaphragms, rigid offsets and construction stages are off. Preserve all fields not explicitly changed. Report every requested signed value with node/member, global direction, unit, case/combination, turn, model state and traceable . Rz denotes the vertical support reaction Fz. Retain original cases and evaluate every listed combination separately. Resolve essential missing or contradictory inputs before reporting new numerical results.

Extend only the second-story right overhang from 1.5 to 2 m by moving tip2 to X=8 m. Keep its original 6 kN/m load intensity over the new actual length. Preserve the lower overhang and the lower-main-beam 22 kN force. Recompute. Report global Ux and Uz at the highest-story rightmost beam-column joint, and global support moment My and vertical reaction Fz at the left base, for every listed case and combination.
